comparison_labels.dqn: DQN (SB3; availability via invalid-action penalties, no action mask)
comparison_labels.maskable_ppo: MaskablePPO (sb3-contrib; masks used in training and evaluation — separate experiment)
comparison_labels.ppo: PPO (SB3; availability via invalid-action penalties, no action mask)
comparison_labels.random_valid: Random-valid control (uniform among masked-valid actions; explicitly seeded)
comparison_labels.recent_performance: Recent-performance baseline (lowest rolling accuracy over prior observed responses in-episode; masked-valid only)
comparison_labels.weakest_mastery: Weakest-mastery heuristic (lowest current mastery among masked-valid skills)

comparison_notes.legacy_alias: Older smoke runs labelled rule_based and lowest_first used the same weakest-mastery heuristic (alias). New runs report weakest_mastery once.
comparison_notes.mask_vs_penalty: weakest_mastery, random_valid, and recent_performance use valid-action masks. Vanilla DQN/PPO learn unavailable actions only through penalties; invalid actions are not silently remapped.
comparison_notes.maskable_ppo_separate: maskable_ppo is opt-in and uses sb3_contrib.MaskablePPO with action_masks() during learn and predict. Do not describe inference-only remapping as masked training.
comparison_notes.mastery_metrics: selected_skill_mastery_gain_sum accumulates per-step gains on the chosen skill only. mean_mastery_delta_final_minus_initial and total_mastery_delta_final_minus_initial compare end vs start mastery across all skills (includes forgetting).
comparison_notes.recent_performance_defined: recent_performance uses a rolling window of previously observed correct/incorrect responses per skill within the episode only. Cold-start prefers untried valid skills (lowest action index). Ties break by lowest action index. This is distinct from weakest_mastery (current mastery) and random_valid.

held_out.evaluation_seeds: Validation and test episode reset seeds use disjoint numeric bands so they do not collide with each other.
held_out.real_data_held_out: ASSISTments learners partitioned into train/validation/test (notebook 01). Response-model fit uses train only.
held_out.simulator_scenarios: sim_train/sim_val/sim_test only change initial prior_strength presets. They are not disjoint real students and are not a substitute for the learner split.

observation.checkpoint_load_note: Observation dimension unchanged; old SB3 zips load. Feature semantics for step_frac differ from pre-v1.1 — re-evaluate under this protocol.
observation.step_frac_semantics_v1_1: elapsed environment steps including invalid-action transitions, divided by max_episode_steps. Learner interaction count is separate (info['learner_interaction_count'] / LearnerSimState.step).

hidden_from_policy_used_by_simulator: blend weight between p_model and mastery
partial_observability.implication: The decision process is partially observable relative to the response simulator's internal history. Policies see mastery and time, not the full count/streak features that drive p_correct.
